title: Re-selection reads the untrimmed posted value while validate_choice trims — a whitespace-padded choice validates but re-renders with the radio unchecked
evidence: references.gleam:237: `selected: common.get_val(values, reference_attestation.field_name),` | reference_attestation.gleam:50: `case common.get_val(values, field_name) |> string.trim {` | reference_attestation.gleam:162: `let checked_attrs = case value == selected {`
detail: The spec change log aligned validator and writer on trimmed values ("validator and writer must agree on what counts as a choice"), but the view's re-selection reader still compares raw get_val. A crafted " attested " passes validate_choice yet renders unchecked on an unrelated error re-render. Tamper-only, cosmetic; browsers post exact radio values.
recommended_fix: Pass `common.get_val(values, reference_attestation.field_name) |> string.trim` as `selected` in references.gleam so the re-selection comparison matches the validator and insert paths.
